title: त्रयोदशाधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: King Janaka, with his ministers and priest, welcomes Shuka, and Shuka asks him how to reach liberation. Janaka explains the four stages of life, saying that after serving the teacher, one should wed, beget sons, and live as a forest-dweller, and that only after finishing these does one find release, and then tells him that he already has what a brahmin wins by liberation.
summary.kn: ರಾಜ ಜನಕ ಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳು, ಪುರೋಹಿತನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಶುಕನನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾಗತಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮೋಕ್ಷ ಹೇಗೆ ಪಡೆಯುವುದೆಂದು ಶುಕ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಜನಕ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಆಶ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿ, ಗುರುಸೇವೆ, ವಿವಾಹ, ಮಕ್ಕಳು, ವಾನಪ್ರಸ್ಥ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮುಕ್ತಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ಮೋಕ್ಷದಿಂದ ಗಳಿಸುವುದು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ನಿನ್ನಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: राजा जनक मन्त्रियों और पुरोहित के साथ शुक का स्वागत करते हैं और शुक मोक्ष पाने का मार्ग पूछते हैं। जनक चार आश्रम समझाते हैं कि गुरुसेवा, विवाह, पुत्र और वानप्रस्थ के बाद ही मुक्ति मिलती है, फिर कहते हैं कि ब्राह्मण मोक्ष से जो पाता है वह उनके पास पहले से है।
summary.te: రాజు జనకుడు మంత్రులు, పురోహితునితో శుకుని స్వాగతిస్తాడు; మోక్షం ఎలా పొందాలని శుకుడు అడుగుతాడు. గురుసేవ, వివాహం, పుత్రులు, వానప్రస్థం తరువాతే విముక్తి అని జనకుడు నాలుగు ఆశ్రమాలను వివరించి, బ్రాహ్మణుడు మోక్షంతో పొందేది నీకు ఇప్పటికే ఉందని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: மன்னன் ஜனகன் அமைச்சர்களும் புரோகிதரும் உடன் சுகரை வரவேற்க, விடுதலை பெறுவது எப்படி என்று சுகர் கேட்கிறார். ஜனகன் நான்கு ஆசிரமங்களை விளக்கி குருசேவை, திருமணம், மக்கள், வானப்பிரஸ்தம் முடித்த பின்பே விடுதலை என்றும், அந்தணன் விடுதலையால் பெறுவது ஏற்கெனவே உன்னிடம் உள்ளது என்றும் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: മന്ത്രിമാരോടും പുരോഹിതനോടും കൂടി ജനകരാജാവ് ശുകനെ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു; മോക്ഷം എങ്ങനെ നേടാമെന്ന് ശുകൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ഗുരുവിനെ സേവിച്ചശേഷം വിവാഹം കഴിച്ച്, പുത്രന്മാരെ ജനിപ്പിച്ച്, വനവാസിയായി ജീവിക്കണമെന്നും, ഇവ പൂർത്തിയാക്കിയശേഷമേ മോചനം ലഭിക്കൂവെന്നും ജനകൻ നാലു ആശ്രമങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു; ബ്രാഹ്മണൻ മോക്ഷത്താൽ നേടുന്നതെന്തോ അത് ശുകന് ഇതിനകം ഉണ്ടെന്നും ജനകൻ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.313; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततः स राजा जनको मन्त्रिभिः सह भारत ।
पुरः पुरोहितं कृत्वा सर्वाण्यन्तःपुराणि च ॥

meaning.en: Then King Janaka, Bharata, with his ministers, placing the household priest and all the women of the palace in front,

verses.text:
आसनं च पुरस्कृत्य रत्नानि विविधानि च ।
शिरसा चार्घ्यमादाय गुरुपुत्रं समभ्यगात् ॥

meaning.en: bearing a seat, various jewels, and a respectful offering on his head, went forward to meet the teacher's son.

verses.text:
स तदासनमादाय बहुरत्नविभूषितम् ।
स्पर्ध्यास्तरणसंस्तीर्णं सर्वतोभद्रमृद्धिमत् ॥

meaning.en: The king took that seat, adorned with many jewels, spread with enviable coverings, auspicious on every side and splendid,

verses.text:
पुरोधसा संगृहीतं हस्तेनालभ्य पार्थिवः ।
प्रददौ गुरुपुत्राय शुकाय परमार्चितम् ॥

meaning.en: laid hold of by the priest, and touching it with his hand, he gave it to Shuka, the teacher's son, as a most honored gift.

verses.text:
तत्रोपविष्टं तं कार्ष्णिं शास्त्रतः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।
पाद्यं निवेद्य प्रथममर्घ्यं गां च न्यवेदयत् ।
स च तां मन्त्रवत्पूजां प्रत्यगृह्णाद्यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: When Krishna's son sat there, the king honored him according to the rules: first offering water for the feet, then the guest-offering and a cow. Shuka accepted that worship with mantras, as is proper.

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां जनकाद्द्विजसत्तमः ।
गां चैव समनुज्ञाय राजानमनुमान्य च ॥

meaning.en: Having received that honor from Janaka, the best of the twice-born gave leave about the cow and showed courtesy to the king.

verses.text:
पर्यपृच्छन्महातेजा राज्ञः कुशलमव्ययम् ।
अनामयं च राजेन्द्र शुकः सानुचरस्य ह ॥

meaning.en: The greatly radiant Shuka then asked about the king's undiminished well-being and health, and that of his attendants, O best of kings.

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातः स तेनाथ निषसाद सहानुगः ।
उदारसत्त्वाभिजनो भूमौ राजा कृताञ्जलिः ॥

meaning.en: Given leave by Shuka, the king, of noble nature and lineage, sat on the ground with his followers, hands folded.

verses.text:
कुशलं चाव्ययं चैव पृष्ट्वा वैयासकिं नृपः ।
किमागमनमित्येव पर्यपृच्छत पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: After asking Vyasa's son about his well-being, the king asked him what the purpose of his coming was.

verses.text: शुक उवाच

meaning.en: Shuka said:

verses.text:
पित्राहमुक्तो भद्रं ते मोक्षधर्मार्थकोविदः ।
विदेहराजो याज्यो मे जनको नाम विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: "My father told me, 'Good fortune to you: Janaka, the renowned king of Videha, is my patron, expert in liberation, dharma, and wealth.

verses.text:
तत्र गच्छस्व वै तूर्णं यदि ते हृदि संशयः ।
प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा स ते छेत्स्यति संशयम् ॥

meaning.en: Go to him at once if you have doubt in your heart about action or renunciation; he will cut your doubt.'

verses.text:
सोऽहं पितुर्नियोगात्त्वामुपप्रष्टुमिहागतः ।
तन्मे धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: So I, on my father's order, have come here to ask you. Best of the upholders of dharma, you should tell me truly.

verses.text:
किं कार्यं ब्राह्मणेनेह मोक्षार्थश्च किमात्मकः ।
कथं च मोक्षः कर्तव्यो ज्ञानेन तपसापि वा ॥

meaning.en: What must a brahmin do in this world, and what is the nature of the goal called liberation? How is liberation to be achieved, by knowledge or by austerity?"

verses.text: जनक उवाच

meaning.en: Janaka said:

verses.text:
यत्कार्यं ब्राह्मणेनेह जन्मप्रभृति तच्छृणु ।
कृतोपनयनस्तात भवेद्वेदपरायणः ॥

meaning.en: "Hear what a brahmin must do from birth onward. After the sacred thread, my son, he should devote himself to the Veda.

verses.text:
तपसा गुरुवृत्त्या च ब्रह्मचर्येण चाभिभो ।
देवतानां पितॄणां चाप्यनृणश्चानसूयकः ॥

meaning.en: By austerity, service to his teacher, and celibacy, mighty one, he should become free of debt to gods and ancestors and free from envy.

verses.text:
वेदानधीत्य नियतो दक्षिणामपवर्ज्य च ।
अभ्यनुज्ञामथ प्राप्य समावर्तेत वै द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: Having studied the Vedas with discipline and given the teacher's fee, the twice-born, after receiving permission, should return home.

verses.text:
समावृत्तस्तु गार्हस्थ्ये सदारो नियतो वसेत् ।
अनसूयुर्यथान्यायमाहिताग्निस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Returned, he should live the householder's life with his wife, self-controlled, without envy, keeping the sacred fires as the rule requires.

verses.text:
उत्पाद्य पुत्रपौत्रं तु वन्याश्रमपदे वसेत् ।
तानेवाग्नीन्यथाशास्त्रमर्चयन्नतिथिप्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Having begotten sons and grandsons, he should live in a forest hermitage, honoring those same fires by the rule and welcoming guests.

verses.text:
स वनेऽग्नीन्यथान्यायमात्मन्यारोप्य धर्मवित् ।
निर्द्वंद्वो वीतरागात्मा ब्रह्माश्रमपदे वसेत् ॥

meaning.en: In the forest, knowing dharma, he should rightly place the fires within himself, and, free of dualities and of passion, live in the stage devoted to Brahman.

verses.text: शुक उवाच

meaning.en: Shuka said:

verses.text:
उत्पन्ने ज्ञानविज्ञाने प्रत्यक्षे हृदि शाश्वते ।
किमवश्यं निवस्तव्यमाश्रमेषु वनेषु च ॥

meaning.en: "When knowledge and realization have arisen, direct and eternal in the heart, must one still live in the stages of life or in the forests?

verses.text:
एतद्भवन्तं पृच्छामि तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ।
यथावेदार्थतत्त्वेन ब्रूहि मे त्वं जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: This I ask you; you ought to tell me. Explain to me, lord of men, according to the true meaning of the Veda."

verses.text: जनक उवाच

meaning.en: Janaka said:

verses.text:
न विना ज्ञानविज्ञानं मोक्षस्याधिगमो भवेत् ।
न विना गुरुसंबन्धं ज्ञानस्याधिगमः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Liberation is not reached without knowledge and realization, and knowledge is not said to be reached without a bond with a teacher.

verses.text:
आचार्यः प्लाविता तस्य ज्ञानं प्लव इहोच्यते ।
विज्ञाय कृतकृत्यस्तु तीर्णस्तदुभयं त्यजेत् ॥

meaning.en: The teacher is the one who ferries across, and knowledge is called the boat here. Having realized and done what was to be done, the one who has crossed should abandon both.

verses.text:
अनुच्छेदाय लोकानामनुच्छेदाय कर्मणाम् ।
पूर्वैराचरितो धर्मश्चातुराश्रम्यसंकथः ॥

meaning.en: So that the worlds and actions would not be cut off, the dharma of the four stages was practiced by those of old.

verses.text:
अनेन क्रमयोगेन बहुजातिषु कर्मणा ।
कृत्वा शुभाशुभं कर्म मोक्षो नामेह लभ्यते ॥

meaning.en: By this gradual path, through actions over many births, after doing good and bad deeds, the thing called liberation is gained here.

verses.text:
भावितैः कारणैश्चायं बहुसंसारयोनिषु ।
आसादयति शुद्धात्मा मोक्षं वै प्रथमाश्रमे ॥

meaning.en: Through matured causes, in many wombs of cycling existence, a purified self attains liberation even in the first stage of life.

verses.text:
तमासाद्य तु मुक्तस्य दृष्टार्थस्य विपश्चितः ।
त्रिष्वाश्रमेषु को न्वर्थो भवेत्परमभीप्सतः ॥

meaning.en: Once he has reached it, what use are the three stages for the liberated, wise man who has seen the goal and desires the highest?

verses.text:
राजसांस्तामसांश्चैव नित्यं दोषान्विवर्जयेत् ।
सात्त्विकं मार्गमास्थाय पश्येदात्मानमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: He should always avoid the faults of passion and darkness, and, taking the path of goodness, see the Self by the Self.

verses.text:
सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
संपश्यन्नोपलिप्येत जले वारिचरो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self, he is not stained, like a water creature in water.

verses.text:
पक्षीव प्लवनादूर्ध्वममुत्रानन्त्यमश्नुते ।
विहाय देहं निर्मुक्तो निर्द्वंद्वः प्रशमं गतः ॥

meaning.en: Like a bird rising above the water, he gains the endless beyond, leaving the body, freed, free of dualities, gone to peace.

verses.text:
अत्र गाथाः पुरा गीताः शृणु राज्ञा ययातिना ।
धार्यन्ते या द्विजैस्तात मोक्षशास्त्रविशारदैः ॥

meaning.en: On this, hear the verses sung of old by King Yayati, which twice-born experts in the science of liberation keep in memory.

verses.text:
ज्योतिरात्मनि नान्यत्र रतं तत्रैव चैव तत् ।
स्वयं च शक्यं तद्द्रष्टुं सुसमाहितचेतसा ॥

meaning.en: The light is in the Self and nowhere else; the mind delights in that alone, and with a well-collected mind one can see it oneself.

verses.text:
न बिभेति परो यस्मान्न बिभेति पराच्च यः ।
यश्च नेच्छति न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥

meaning.en: When one fears no one else, and no one else fears him, and he neither desires nor hates, then he attains Brahman.

verses.text:
यदा भावं न कुरुते सर्वभूतेषु पापकम् ।
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥

meaning.en: When he harbors no evil feeling toward any being, in deed, mind, or speech, then he attains Brahman.

verses.text:
संयोज्य तपसात्मानमीर्ष्यामुत्सृज्य मोहिनीम् ।
त्यक्त्वा कामं च लोभं च ततो ब्रह्मत्वमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: Joining the self to austerity, casting off bewildering envy, and abandoning desire and greed, he then attains the state of Brahman.

verses.text:
यदा श्रव्ये च दृश्ये च सर्वभूतेषु चाप्ययम् ।
समो भवति निर्द्वंद्वो ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥

meaning.en: When toward what is heard and what is seen, and toward all beings, he becomes even-minded and free of dualities, then he attains Brahman.

verses.text:
यदा स्तुतिं च निन्दां च समत्वेनैव पश्यति ।
काञ्चनं चायसं चैव सुखदुःखे तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: When he looks with equality on praise and blame, gold and iron, and likewise pleasure and pain,

verses.text:
शीतमुष्णं तथैवार्थमनर्थं प्रियमप्रियम् ।
जीवितं मरणं चैव ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥

meaning.en: cold and heat, gain and loss, the dear and the unwelcome, life and death, then he attains Brahman.

verses.text:
प्रसार्येह यथाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः ।
तथेन्द्रियाणि मनसा संयन्तव्यानि भिक्षुणा ॥

meaning.en: As a tortoise stretches out its limbs and draws them in again, so a mendicant must restrain the senses with the mind.

verses.text:
तमःपरिगतं वेश्म यथा दीपेन दृश्यते ।
तथा बुद्धिप्रदीपेन शक्य आत्मा निरीक्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: As a house wrapped in darkness is seen by a lamp, so the Self can be seen by the lamp of understanding.

verses.text:
एतत्सर्वं प्रपश्यामि त्वयि बुद्धिमतां वर ।
यच्चान्यदपि वेत्तव्यं तत्त्वतो वेद तद्भवान् ॥

meaning.en: All this I see in you, best of the wise; and whatever else is to be known, you know it in truth.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मर्षे विदितश्चासि विषयान्तमुपागतः ।
गुरोस्तव प्रसादेन तव चैवोपशिक्षया ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin sage, I know you have reached the end of sense objects, through your teacher's grace and your own training.

verses.text:
तस्यैव च प्रसादेन प्रादुर्भूतं महामुने ।
ज्ञानं दिव्यं ममापीदं तेनासि विदितो मम ॥

meaning.en: Through that same grace, great sage, this divine knowledge has also arisen in me, and by it you are known to me.

verses.text:
अधिकं तव विज्ञानमधिका च गतिस्तव ।
अधिकं च तवैश्वर्यं तच्च त्वं नावबुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Your realization is greater, your destination is greater, and your lordship is greater, and this you do not recognize.

verses.text:
बाल्याद्वा संशयाद्वापि भयाद्वाप्यविमोक्षजात् ।
उत्पन्ने चापि विज्ञाने नाधिगच्छति तां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Through childishness, doubt, or fear of failing to be freed, some, even when realization has arisen, do not reach that goal.

verses.text:
व्यवसायेन शुद्धेन मद्विधैश्छिन्नसंशयः ।
विमुच्य हृदयग्रन्थीनासादयति तां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: With pure resolve, those like me have their doubts cut; releasing the knots of the heart, they reach that goal.

verses.text:
भवांश्चोत्पन्नविज्ञानः स्थिरबुद्धिरलोलुपः ।
व्यवसायादृते ब्रह्मन्नासादयति तत्परम् ॥

meaning.en: You have realization, steady understanding, and no greed; yet without resolve, brahmin, none attains the Supreme.

verses.text:
नास्ति ते सुखदुःखेषु विशेषो नास्ति लोलुपा ।
नौत्सुक्यं नृत्तगीतेषु न राग उपजायते ॥

meaning.en: In you there is no distinction between pleasure and pain, no craving, no eagerness for dance and song, and no attachment arises.

verses.text:
न बन्धुषु निबन्धस्ते न भयेष्वस्ति ते भयम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां महाभाग तुल्यलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनम् ॥

meaning.en: You have no tie to kin and no fear in fearful things; great one, I see you holding clod, stone, and gold as equal.

verses.text:
अहं च त्वानुपश्यामि ये चाप्यन्ये मनीषिणः ।
आस्थितं परमं मार्गमक्षयं तमनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: I see you, as do other wise men, as one who has taken the highest path, imperishable and free of ill.

verses.text:
यत्फलं ब्राह्मणस्येह मोक्षार्थश्च यदात्मकः ।
तस्मिन्वै वर्तसे विप्र किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: The fruit a brahmin seeks here, and the nature of the aim called liberation: you already abide in that. Why do you ask anything more, brahmin?"
